name: richfrem-agent-plugins-skills
description: A curated collection of AI agent plugins and skills for Claude Code — covering spec-driven development, memory management, context bundling, multi-agent orchestration, CLI sub-agents, and more.

plugins.name: exploration-cycle-plugin
plugins.description: Autonomous discovery, business requirements capture, and prototyping loop for spec-driven engineering.

plugins.name: agent-agentic-os
plugins.description: Eval-gated continuous improvement OS — structured memory hierarchy, improvement loops, session lifecycle, and ecosystem evolution orchestration.

plugins.name: agent-loops
plugins.description: Composable agent loop architectures for learning loops, agent orchestration (0-to-N inner agents), and red team coordination. Framework-agnostic.

plugins.name: agent-scaffolders
plugins.description: Meta-plugin containing ecosystem generation primitives. Scaffolding for agent skills, plugins, CLI sub-agents, custom GitHub Copilot agents, GitHub Agentic Workflows (gh-aw), CI/CD Smart Failure agents, and Azure Foundry agents.

plugins.name: agent-memory
plugins.description: Unified Cognitive Memory & Retrieval Suite — 13 skills across RLM keyword search, ChromaDB vector semantic search, and multi-tiered session memory management.

plugins.name: obsidian-wiki-engine
plugins.description: Obsidian Agent Integration Suite — vault operations, markdown parsing, canvas creation, graph traversal, and bases management for AI-assisted Obsidian workflows.

plugins.name: cli-agents
plugins.description: Multi-LLM Task Router Suite. run_agent.py routes bounded tasks to 6 backends (Claude, Copilot, Gemini, Agy, Codex, local Gemma 4 12B — ~2s). 11 expert agent personas: security auditor, red-team reviewer, architect review, compliance, PR reviewer, test writer, debate synthesizer, output validator, self-critic, performance analyst, refactor expert. Includes model catalog manager (update-cli-models), KV cache orchestrator and API compatibility proxy. v2.1.0.

plugins.name: dev-utils
plugins.description: Unified Developer Utilities Suite — 17 skills covering ADR management, coding conventions, context bundling, Mermaid diagrams, GitHub issue logging & friction management, GitHub issue backlog bridge, issue prioritizer & Projects v2 sync, issue worktree manager, issue PR lifecycle orchestrator, HuggingFace integration, text humanization, link validation, task tracking, symlink management, and agent context hygiene.

plugins.name: plugin-manager
plugins.description: Orchestration hub for the plugin ecosystem. Manages canonical source-keyed installations, unified package removal, and synchronized updates across all agent environments.

plugins.name: dependency-management
plugins.description: Python dependency management with pip-compile locked-file workflow and tiered hierarchy for Python backends.
